theme_title: Isha Ambani says Jio IPO marks a promise, renews Dhirubhai Ambani’s trust with investors
summary: Isha Ambani described Jio Platforms’ stock market debut as a promise to honour the trust of investors and customers, nearly five decades after Dhirubhai Ambani took Reliance Industries public. Jio’s Rs 30,200-crore IPO attracted over Rs 7 lakh crore in demand, with the stock listing at a 21.3% premium.
